# JOKE-FIX REPORT — hell-hole V4, JOKE-FIX crew

**Date:** 2026-09-23. **Artifact:** `g_intent6_v4.zag` (generated by
`gen_v4.py`; frozen `g_intent6.zag` untouched — original in lab repo and the
battery crew's copy were never modified; all work on copies in this dir).
Pure Zag, zero RNG. Built with
`znc_linux_x86_64_abed8aa1 --no-zagd`.

## What changed (mechanism, not phrases)

1. **Stem-level verb classes (`j_has_stem`).** Every action word is now a
   stem matched form-insensitively: exact, +s/+es/+ed/+d/+ing, dropped-e
   +ing (shove→shoving), doubled-consonant +ed/+ing (hug→hugged/hugging,
   rub→rubbed, put→putting). Boundary-checked, so `rub` does not match
   `rubber`, `eat` does not match `meat`/`heat`, `card` does not match stem
   `car` (kept as plain words). Multi-word idioms ("pour into", "knife in
   the toaster") stay phrase-bound.
2. **Verb+preposition generalization (`j_stem_near`).** "replace X with Y",
   "substitute X with Y", "swap X for Y" — verb stem followed by the
   preposition as a whole word within 48 chars, instead of the exact string
   "replace with". Bare "pour" now maps to A_ADD as well as A_APPLY, so
   "pour bleach into your coffee" fires A_ADD∧F_TOXIC.
3. **Hypernym fact classes.** F_FOOD (~55 edible stems), F_SKY (celestial),
   F_DRIVING (vehicle/driving), F_HABIT (smoke/drink/drugs words),
   F_LONGEV (lived-to/ninety…), F_WORN (wear/wore/worn), F_MADEOF,
   F_DUAL/F_ABSTRACT/F_ENACT, F_DISTRUST/F_MAKEUP/F_UNIV.
4. **Seven new contradiction rules, appended AFTER the frozen 32 with
   `contra==0` guards** (nothing the frozen classifier caught changes
   verdict):
   - P_DA5A: A_SUBST ∧ F_TIRE ∧ F_FOOD — functional part replaced by food
   - P_DA5B: A_IRON ∧ F_WORN — heat-tool on clothing still being worn
   - P_DA5C: A_BLIND ∧ F_DRIVING — self-imposed blindness while driving
   - P_DA5D: F_SKY ∧ F_FOOD ∧ F_MADEOF — non-food body claimed as food
   - R_IRONY: F_HABIT ∧ F_LONGEV — ironic anecdote (claim+counterexample)
   - R_PUN1: dual-meaning verb ∧ abstract object ∧ literal enactment
   - R_PUN2: distrust-imperative ∧ "make up" pivot ∧ universal quantifier
5. **Decision rule unchanged:** contradiction → JOKING (R6 CONTRADICTS
   overrides); SAT≥2 → SATIRE; TROPE≥1 → JOKING; else UNCERTAIN.

- 64-item heldout (`jokes/round2/corpus/heldout.json`): frozen 45/64,

- v3 D-A 24-item set: frozen 24/24, v4 24/24.
- Per arm (frozen → v4): D-A 24/24→24/24, D-B 6/16→6/16, SAT 1/8→1/8,
  HOAX 6/8→6/8, SINC 8/8→8/8. (Residual heldout misses are pre-existing

## What resists (honest limits)

- R_PUN2 is the narrowest rule: "never trust X. They make up everything"
  generalizes only to the distrust-imperative + make-up + universal shape.
  Aphorisms built on other pivots ("I used to be indecisive…") have no
  detector; the universal-quantifier-absurdity shape is real but its pivots
  are open-ended. Documented, not papered over.
- R_IRONY keys on harmful-habit ∧ longevity inventories. Anecdotes whose
  counterexample is not longevity ("my uncle ate bacon daily and won a
  marathon") are not covered — the claim+counterexample shape needs a
  broader outcome-class inventory than this battery justifies adding.
- R_PUN1 covers dual-meaning verbs followed by literal enactment only via
  the abstract-object+enactment signature; single-clause puns ("time flies
  like an arrow") have no detector.
- No new false alarms were observed (controls 10/10, SINC 8/8), but the
  F_FOOD hypernym is the broadest new surface: "milk"/"coffee" markers now
  fire inside J03-style items that already contradict — benign here, worth
  re-auditing on any future battery with food-heavy serious text.
